title: Nine-Tail's Blaze

body:
# ‌Modpack Introduction‌
"Nine-Tail’s Blaze" is a lightweight survival modpack meticulously crafted for Minecraft enthusiasts. It preserves the core essence of vanilla survival while enhancing gameplay through curated mods, delivering smoother survival, more creative building, and more thrilling adventures. Both newcomers and seasoned players will find their own enjoyment in this deceptively simple modpack.
# ‌Key Features‌
‌Performance Optimization.\
‌
・Includes optimization mods like ‌Sodium‌ for seamless gameplay.
# ‌Survival Enhancements‌
・‌Item Manager‌: Convenient recipe viewing.\
・‌Xaero’s Minimap‌: Real-time location tracking.\
・‌Jade‌: Block state inspection.\
・‌Skybox Support & Mob Resource Pack Mods‌:\
Direct compatibility with skybox/texture packs.\
・Built-in select high-quality resource packs.
# ‌Target Audience‌
Players who enjoy vanilla survival but seek subtle optimizations while staying true to the core experience.
# 整合包简介
「九尾之焰」是为Minecraft生存爱好者精心打造的基础整合包，。本整合包保留了Minecraft原版生存的核心乐趣，同时通过精选模组优化了游戏体验，让生存更流畅、建造更自由、冒险更精彩。无论是新手玩家还是生存老手，都能在这款简约而不简单的整合包中找到属于自己的乐趣。
# 特色内容
性能优化：\
包含Sodium等优化模组，确保游戏运行流畅
# 生存增强：
添加了物品管理器，方便查看合成表\
添加了Xaero的地图方便查看位置\
添加了Jade可以方便查看方块状态\
添加了天空盒支持模组和生物资源包模组，你可以直接使用有关天空盒和生物纹理的资源包\
**内置了部分精美的材质包**
# 适合人群
喜欢原版生存但希望有适度优化辅助以原版为主的玩家
